hi.id.instruction.head3: Before applying for land, applicant must be ready with the following
hi.id.instruction13: Scanned passport size photo of applicant (in JPG or JPEG Format Maximum 100 KB) and scanned signature of applicant (in JPG or JPEG Format Maximum 20 KB).
hi.id.instruction14: Scanned copy of acknowledgement of Industrial Entrepreneur Memorandum (IEM) or Industrial License or Entrepreneur Memorandum (If Enterprise is Micro/Small/Medium)/Self Declaration Form as per the prevailing rules and laws.
hi.id.instruction15: Scanned copy of project report/scheme (signed by Authorized Signatory), with full details of Plant & Machinery / Equipment and requisite constructed area for industrial shed, godown for products, raw materials, office along with process charts, cost, means of finance, etc.
hi.id.instruction16: Scanned copy of Layout plan of the proposed construction justifying the utilization of land and estimation of cost of constructed area/shed.
hi.id.instruction17: Name and address of all the partners indicating their shares in the firm. Also attach photo-stat/attested copies of the partnership deed and Registration certificate under Partnership Act in case of Partnership Firm.
hi.id.instruction18: Scanned copy of Memorandum and Articles of Association of the company, registration certificate under the Companies Act,along with a copy of the resolution passed by the Board Of Directors in support of application for allotment of land - in case Pvt. Ltd./ Public Ltd./ LLP Enterprise.
hi.id.instruction19: Registration no. and date along with a scanned copy of the resolution passed by the executive committee. Also enclose photo-stat copies of bylaws and registration certificate under Co-Operative Societies Act - in case of a Co-Operative Society.
hi.id.instruction20: Scanned copy of an authorization letter signed by the competent authority of applicant empowering the authorized signatory for signing the various documents and completing the necessary formalities related to allotment - in case if Enterprise is not Proprietary.
hi.id.instruction21: Scanned copy of time schedule/PERT (Program Evaluation and Review Technique) chart for completion of various stages of implementation of the project.
hi.id.instruction22: Advance Premium (25% of Premium Charges) + Application Fees (Rs.2000/- (Rupees Two Thousand) in case of Micro/Small, Rs. 5000/- (Rupees Five Thousand) in case of Medium and Rs. 10000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) in case of Large Industry).
